with 
    scoped_bindings as (
      select
        b.id as binding_id,
        b.provider,
        b.external_bot_id,
        a.id as agent_id,
        a.name as agent_name,
        a.display_name as agent_display_name,
        b.bot_avatar_url as agent_avatar_source_url,
        a.runtime_provider
      from im_bindings b
      inner join agents a on a.id = b.agent_id
      where a.created_by_user_id = $1::uuid
        and a.status <> 'deleted'
        
        
    ),
    channels as (
      select distinct on (s.im_binding_id, s.channel_id)
        s.im_binding_id,
        s.channel_id,
        s.conversation_kind
      from sessions s
      inner join scoped_bindings sb on sb.binding_id = s.im_binding_id
      where s.kind in ('channel', 'thread')
        
      order by s.im_binding_id, s.channel_id, (s.ended_at is null) desc, (s.kind = 'channel') desc, s.created_at desc, s.id desc
    ),
    thread_roots as (
      select distinct on (m.im_binding_id, m.channel_id, m.thread_key)
        m.im_binding_id,
        m.channel_id,
        m.thread_key,
        m.provider_context ->> 'rootId' as root_external_id
      from im_messages m
      inner join scoped_bindings sb on sb.binding_id = m.im_binding_id
      where m.direction = 'inbound'
        and m.thread_key is not null
        and m.provider_context ->> 'rootId' is not null
        and m.provider_context ->> 'rootId' <> m.thread_key
        
      order by m.im_binding_id, m.channel_id, m.thread_key, m.occurred_at asc, m.provider_revision_key asc, m.id asc
    ),
    classified_messages as (
      select
        m.id,
        m.im_binding_id,
        m.channel_id,
        m.external_message_id,
        m.provider_revision_key,
        m.occurred_at,
        m.thread_key,
        case
          when ch.conversation_kind = 'dm' then null
          else coalesce(tr.root_external_id, m.thread_key, m.external_message_id)
        end as topic_key
      from im_messages m
      inner join scoped_bindings sb on sb.binding_id = m.im_binding_id
      left join channels ch on ch.im_binding_id = m.im_binding_id and ch.channel_id = m.channel_id
      left join thread_roots tr
        on tr.im_binding_id = m.im_binding_id
        and tr.channel_id = m.channel_id
        and tr.thread_key = m.thread_key
      where m.direction = 'inbound'
        
    ),
    topic_messages as (
      select * from classified_messages cm where true 
    ),
    title_sessions as (
      select
        s.id,
        s.im_binding_id,
        s.channel_id,
        s.kind,
        s.conversation_kind,
        s.manual_title,
        s.generated_title,
        s.ended_at,
        s.created_at,
        case
          when s.conversation_kind = 'dm' then null
          else coalesce(tr.root_external_id, s.thread_key)
        end as topic_key
      from sessions s
      inner join scoped_bindings sb on sb.binding_id = s.im_binding_id
      left join thread_roots tr
        on tr.im_binding_id = s.im_binding_id
        and tr.channel_id = s.channel_id
        and tr.thread_key = s.thread_key
      where (s.kind = 'thread' or (s.kind = 'channel' and s.conversation_kind = 'dm'))
        
    ),
    topic_sessions as (
      select distinct on (ts.im_binding_id, ts.channel_id, ts.topic_key) ts.*
      from title_sessions ts
      where true 
      order by ts.im_binding_id, ts.channel_id, ts.topic_key, (ts.ended_at is null) desc, (ts.kind = 'channel') desc, ts.created_at desc, ts.id desc
    ),
    channel_sessions as (
      select distinct on (s.im_binding_id, s.channel_id)
        s.im_binding_id,
        s.channel_id,
        s.ended_at
      from sessions s
      inner join scoped_bindings sb on sb.binding_id = s.im_binding_id
      where s.kind = 'channel'
        
      order by s.im_binding_id, s.channel_id, (s.ended_at is null) desc, s.created_at desc, s.id desc
    ),
    thread_owned as (
      select distinct d.message_id
      from im_message_deliveries d
      inner join topic_messages tm on tm.id = d.message_id
      inner join sessions s on s.id = d.session_id
      where s.kind = 'thread'
    ),
    executions as (
      select
        d.id,
        d.session_id,
        d.message_id,
        d.attention,
        d.state,
        d.accepted_at,
        d.steered_at,
        d.expires_at,
        d.attempt_count,
        d.turn_id,
        d.reason,
        d.last_error_code,
        tm.im_binding_id,
        tm.channel_id,
        tm.topic_key,
        root.id as steer_target_delivery_id,
        root.turn_id as steer_target_turn_id,
        case when d.state = 'steered' then root.reported_at else d.reported_at end as reported_at,
        case when d.state = 'steered' then root.turn_report else d.turn_report end as turn_report,
        case
          when d.state = 'accepted'
            and d.reported_at is null
            and d.expires_at > $2::timestamptz
            and ds.ended_at is null
          then not exists (
            select 1
            from im_message_deliveries later
            where later.session_id = d.session_id
              and later.state = 'accepted'
              and (later.accepted_at, later.id) > (d.accepted_at, d.id)
          )
          else false
        end as is_running,
        greatest(
          tm.occurred_at,
          coalesce(d.accepted_at, tm.occurred_at),
          coalesce(d.steered_at, tm.occurred_at),
          coalesce(case when d.state = 'steered' then root.reported_at else d.reported_at end, tm.occurred_at),
          coalesce(
            case when d.state = 'expired' and d.reason = $3 then d.expires_at end,
            tm.occurred_at
          )
        ) as activity_at
      from im_message_deliveries d
      inner join topic_messages tm on tm.id = d.message_id
      inner join sessions ds on ds.id = d.session_id
      left join im_message_deliveries root on root.id = d.steer_target_delivery_id
      left join thread_owned tw on tw.message_id = d.message_id
      where not (d.state = 'expired' and d.reason = 'superseded_revision')
        and not (d.attention = 'ambient' and ds.kind = 'channel' and tw.message_id is not null)
    )
    ,
      topics as (
        select distinct on (im_binding_id, channel_id, topic_key)
          im_binding_id,
          channel_id,
          topic_key,
          has_running,
          has_pending,
          last_execution_at,
          id as latest_execution_id,
          state as latest_state,
          reason as latest_reason,
          is_running as latest_running,
          reported_at as latest_reported_at,
          turn_report as latest_turn_report
        from (
          select
            e.*,
            bool_or(e.is_running) over w as has_running,
            bool_or(e.state = 'pending') over w as has_pending,
            bool_or(e.attention = 'direct') over w as has_direct,
            max(e.activity_at) over w as last_execution_at
          from executions e
          window w as (partition by e.im_binding_id, e.channel_id, e.topic_key)
        ) ranked
        where has_direct
        order by im_binding_id, channel_id, topic_key, activity_at desc, id desc
      ),
      message_topics as (
        select distinct on (im_binding_id, channel_id, topic_key)
          im_binding_id,
          channel_id,
          topic_key,
          anchor_at,
          has_thread,
          id as anchor_id,
          external_message_id as anchor_external_id
        from (
          select
            tm.*,
            min(tm.occurred_at) over w as anchor_at,
            bool_or(tm.thread_key is not null) over w as has_thread
          from topic_messages tm
          window w as (partition by tm.im_binding_id, tm.channel_id, tm.topic_key)
        ) ranked
        order by im_binding_id, channel_id, topic_key, occurred_at asc, provider_revision_key asc, id asc
      )
    
  ,
      
    topic_page as (
      
    select
      mt.im_binding_id,
      mt.channel_id,
      mt.topic_key,
      t.has_running,
      t.has_pending,
      t.latest_execution_id,
      t.latest_state,
      t.latest_reason,
      t.latest_running,
      t.latest_reported_at,
      t.latest_turn_report,
      mt.anchor_id,
      mt.anchor_at,
      mt.anchor_external_id,
      (mt.topic_key is not null and mt.has_thread) as is_thread,
      greatest(mt.anchor_at, coalesce(t.last_execution_at, mt.anchor_at)) as last_activity_at
    from message_topics mt
    inner join topics t
      on t.im_binding_id = mt.im_binding_id
      and t.channel_id = mt.channel_id
      and t.topic_key = mt.topic_key
    where mt.topic_key is not null
      
    
    
  
  
      union all
      
    select
      mt.im_binding_id,
      mt.channel_id,
      mt.topic_key,
      t.has_running,
      t.has_pending,
      t.latest_execution_id,
      t.latest_state,
      t.latest_reason,
      t.latest_running,
      t.latest_reported_at,
      t.latest_turn_report,
      mt.anchor_id,
      mt.anchor_at,
      mt.anchor_external_id,
      (mt.topic_key is not null and mt.has_thread) as is_thread,
      greatest(mt.anchor_at, coalesce(t.last_execution_at, mt.anchor_at)) as last_activity_at
    from message_topics mt
    inner join topics t
      on t.im_binding_id = mt.im_binding_id
      and t.channel_id = mt.channel_id
      and t.topic_key is null
    where mt.topic_key is null
      
    
    
  
  
    ),
    page as (
      select *
      from topic_page
      where true
        
      order by last_activity_at desc, anchor_id desc
      limit $4
    )
  
      select
        p.anchor_id as id,
        sb.agent_id as "agentId",
        sb.agent_name as "agentName",
        sb.agent_display_name as "agentDisplayName",
        sb.agent_avatar_source_url as "agentAvatarSourceUrl",
        sb.runtime_provider as "runtimeProvider",
        sb.provider,
        coalesce(ch.conversation_kind, 'channel') as "conversationKind",
        case when p.is_thread then 'thread' else 'channel' end as "sessionKind",
        p.channel_id as "channelId",
        case when p.is_thread then p.topic_key else null end as "threadKey",
        p.anchor_at as "createdAt",
        case when ts.id is not null then ts.ended_at else cs.ended_at end as "endedAt",
        ts.manual_title as "manualTitle",
        ts.generated_title as "generatedTitle",
        p.last_activity_at as "lastActivityAt",
        title.content ->> 'fallbackText' as "fallbackText",
        title.content as "titleContent",
        sb.external_bot_id as "addressedExternalId",
        p.has_running as "hasRunning",
        p.has_pending as "hasPending",
        p.latest_state as "deliveryState",
        p.latest_reason as "deliveryReason",
        p.latest_running as "latestRunning",
        p.latest_reported_at as "reportedAt",
        p.latest_turn_report as "turnReport",
        to_char(p.last_activity_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as "cursorAt"
      from page p
      inner join scoped_bindings sb on sb.binding_id = p.im_binding_id
      left join channels ch on ch.im_binding_id = p.im_binding_id and ch.channel_id = p.channel_id
      left join channel_sessions cs on cs.im_binding_id = p.im_binding_id and cs.channel_id = p.channel_id
      left join lateral (
        select ts.id, ts.manual_title, ts.generated_title, ts.ended_at
        from topic_sessions ts
        where ts.im_binding_id = p.im_binding_id
          and ts.channel_id = p.channel_id
          and (ts.topic_key = p.topic_key or (ts.topic_key is null and p.topic_key is null))
        limit 1
      ) ts on true
      left join lateral (
        select m.content
        from im_messages m
        where m.im_binding_id = p.im_binding_id
          and m.channel_id = p.channel_id
          and m.external_message_id = p.anchor_external_id
          and m.direction = 'inbound'
        order by m.occurred_at desc, m.provider_revision_key desc, m.id desc
        limit 1
      ) title on true
      order by p.last_activity_at desc, p.anchor_id desc

    inner join topics t

      from page p
      inner join scoped_bindings sb on sb.binding_id = p.im_binding_id
      left join channels ch on ch.im_binding_id = p.im_binding_id and ch.channel_id = p.channel_id
      left join channel_sessions cs on cs.im_binding_id = p.im_binding_id and cs.channel_id = p.channel_id
      left join lateral (

        where ts.im_binding_id = p.im_binding_id
          and ts.channel_id = p.channel_id
          and (ts.topic_key = p.topic_key or (ts.topic_key is null and p.topic_key is null))
        limit 1
      ) ts on true
      left join lateral (
        select m.content
        from im_messages m
        where m.im_binding_id = p.im_binding_id
          and m.channel_id = p.channel_id
          and m.external_message_id = p.anchor_external_id
          and m.direction = 'inbound'
        order by m.occurred_at desc, m.provider_revision_key desc, m.id desc
        limit 1
      ) title on true
      order by p.last_activity_at desc, p.anchor_id desc

      where e.accepted_at is not null
        -- A window that ends before the creator's earliest child cannot hold one. Dropping those
        -- executions here keeps the successor lookup off the history: the fixture's 50,000 windows
        -- all end before the Sessions they would have spawned, so nothing is probed at all.
        and coalesce(e.reported_at, 'infinity'::timestamptz) >= cc.first_created_at
    ),
    spawned as (
      select id, created_at from spawned_roots
      union all
      select child.id, child.created_at
      from sessions child
      inner join spawned parent on child.created_by_session_id = parent.id
    ),
    internal_related as (
      select id, created_at from inherited
      union
      select id, created_at from spawned
    ),
    owner_sessions as (
      select ts.id
      from title_sessions ts
      where ts.im_binding_id = $17::uuid
        and ts.channel_id = $18
        and ts.topic_key = $19
    ),
    related_sessions as (
      select id from internal_related
      union
      select id from owner_sessions
    )
  
      select
        sm.id,
        sm.source_session_id as "sourceSessionId",
        sm.scheduled_origin as "scheduledOrigin",
        sm.target_session_id as "targetSessionId",
        sm.content,
        sm.last_outcome as "outcome",
        sm.attempt_count as "attemptCount",
        sm.last_error_code as "lastErrorCode",
        sm.created_at as "createdAt",
        sm.updated_at as "updatedAt",
        to_char(sm.created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as "cursorAt"
      from (
        -- The page is cut on the message identity alone, so it reads an ordered index rather than
        -- every message body; only the rows that survive resolve their stored content.
        select m.id
        from session_messages m
        where (
            m.source_session_id = any (array(select id from related_sessions))
            or m.target_session_id = any (array(select id from related_sessions))
          )
          
        order by m.created_at asc, m.id asc
        limit $20
      ) p
      inner join session_messages sm on sm.id = p.id
      order by sm.created_at asc, sm.id asc
